name: Aing-Tii homeworld
description: This planet was the homeworld of the Aing-Tii, a secretive race of aliens with a unique perspective of the Force. Located deep within the Kathol Rift, a volatile area of space in the Outer Rim Territories, its location was a secret to the rest of the galaxy.
